title: Nature of Control Classification
prompt:
Nature of Control Classification — Is the control's nature correctly classified based on how it is actually performed?

The recorded field is control_type_ma. Allowed values are Manual, Automated, and Semi-Automated. Treat Semi-Automated as IT-Dependent Manual (a manual control that relies on a system or IT report).

Compare that recorded value to the control description and objective. Assess alignment as: Strong, Partial, or Weak.
- Strong: Manual, Automated, or Semi-Automated matches how the control is performed.
- Partial: the performance is mixed, so the recorded nature is only partly right.
- Weak: the recorded nature does not match how the control is actually performed.

Return alignment, alignment_rationale (max 3 sentences), and proposed_solution (max 3 sentences). If the design text is too thin to judge, set status to insufficient_data.
